films.title: Aftershock

films.title: I'm Not Crazy!
films.overview: A woman enters a quirky mental health clinic after attempting suicide upon finding out her husband is having an affair with her best friend.

films.title: No Filter

films.title: Sweet Family
films.overview: A fat woman attempts to lose weight in order to use her mother's wedding dress with the help of  her evil sisters and needy fiancé.
